direction.situation: On a rainy Colombo roadside, the farewell is over. Anudi continues away as Kasun returns to his food three-wheeler, the interruption still weighing on their parting.
direction.people: Anudi recedes into left depth in a plain cream blouse and muted teal skirt, subdued, with her phone lowered in her right hand, umbrella in her left and handbag on her left forearm. Kasun walks toward the three-wheeler in right depth in a faded blue short-sleeved shirt and dark trousers, hands empty and head slightly lowered, still distracted by the encounter.

flow.text: Both continue along their diverging paths, facing away. Neither turns back; Kasun keeps his head slightly lowered.
Anudi maintains a steady pace into left depth, keeping her phone lowered. Kasun takes measured steps toward the three-wheeler in right depth without reaching for anything or beginning another task.
The wet roadside opens between them as their full figures remain small and separated near opposite edges of the depth composition. Both keep moving away, leaving the shared space empty.

direction.camera: A roadside eye-level wide shot on a 32mm lens makes one slow dolly backward over four seconds, expanding the wet foreground between their diverging paths.
direction.sound: Continuous light rain, distant road wash and soft receding footsteps on wet ground; no speech and no music.
